summary: Outer generator return during yield* calls inner return when present and processes its IteratorResult.

semantics.inner_return_done_false: yield inner value and keep pending return flow
semantics.inner_return_done_true: complete outer return with inner returned value

tests.name: return forwarded
tests.input: function* inner(){try{yield 1}finally{console.log("inner close")}} function* outer(){yield* inner()} const it=outer();it.next();it.return(9);

tests.name: inner return can yield done false
tests.input: const inner={next(){return {value:1,done:false}},return(v){return {value:v+1,done:false}},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}}; function* g(){yield* inner} const it=g();it.next();console.log(it.return(4));
